summary: Require every guarded change to discover and acknowledge reverse dependencies, existing tests, related docs/contracts and candidate audit findings before implementation can be accepted.

impactAnalysis.notes: This governance change strengthens acceptance criteria rather than changing runtime product behavior. Existing change-gate tests, CI wiring, canonical governance documents and historical audit/closure records that reference the gate are explicitly reviewed. F-004 is a discovery candidate because it references the developer entrypoint/change-gate workflow, but its closed documentation alignment remains valid and is not functionally changed. Other listed findings remain unchanged; the new sweep prevents future remediation from silently missing dependent code/tests/findings.

risk.notes: The gate intentionally becomes stricter and may reject changes until all automatically discovered dependents, tests, docs and finding candidates are explicitly reviewed. Runtime application behavior is unchanged.

migration.notes: No product or persisted-data migration is required. Future change declarations must use schemaVersion 2 and include impactAnalysis.

rollback: Revert the full-system impact sweep governance commits to restore schemaVersion 1 and path/domain-only change verification.
